description: This file defines a utility object for scheduling and canceling event reminder notifications using Android's WorkManager API. It specifies constraints for the work and manages periodic scheduling.

classes.name: NotificationScheduler
classes.description: A singleton object that provides methods to schedule and cancel periodic event reminder notifications.

methods.name: scheduleReminders
methods.description: Sets up a periodic work request to send event reminders, with constraints to not require network and require battery not low.

methods.name: cancelReminders
methods.description: Cancels the scheduled event reminders based on the work name.
